g.text: AnchorPoint — two-site link · each site exits via the other · overlay 10.0.80.1 ↔ .2

LEAK-PROOF (fail-closed): each exit subnet → its tunnel via routing-rule action=lookup-only-in-table — NO fallback to the local WAN. Tunnel down ⇒ exit traffic is dropped, never leaked. FastTrack disabled; src-NAT to the overlay IP gives a clean return path.
WireGuard tunnel · UDP 51820 · carries each site's EXIT traffic to the other's WAN
